units.source_text: 藤壶皇后即将离去，舍不得与太子分别，对他说了千言万语。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo was about to leave, and unable to bear parting from the Crown Prince, she said countless things to him.

units.source_text: 然而太子毕竟年事尚幼，未能深切理会，母后心中不免怅惘。

en.t: Yet the Crown Prince was still very young after all and could not truly understand, so his mother could not help feeling sorrowful and wistful.

units.source_text: 太子本来睡得很早，今天为了母后即将离去，至此时尚未就睡。

en.t: The Crown Prince usually went to sleep early, but because his mother was leaving today, he had still not gone to bed even at this hour.

units.source_text: 母后出宫之时，他虽然伤心饮泣，但并未牵衣顿足。

en.t: When his mother left the palace, he wept in sadness, but he did not cling to her sleeves or stamp his feet.
His mother found him deeply pitiable.
